name: deck-properties-decisions
body: deck-properties decisions. [with user] (1) the existing deck-wide config values `title`, `author`, `date` from `kalide.yaml` are exposed to templates; (2) a new `properties:` block lets the author declare arbitrary deck-wide key/value pairs readable throughout the deck, and `properties` is the ONE new allowed top-level key while every other top-level unknown key still errors with a closest-match suggestion; (3) per-slide metadata — at least the current slide number and the total number of slides — is available to templates, derived at render time, not authored frontmatter; (4) deck-wide properties AND per-slide metadata are available inside sections, not just slide layouts. [autonomous — exposure mechanism and value shape, chosen against the graph; flag for coordinator] (a) the context is DATA, not a helper: template-language fixes the v1 helper set at exactly `media` and says adding a helper is a spec change, so no helper is added; (b) deck-wide data is exposed under the reserved top-level key `deck` (`.deck.title`/`.deck.author`/`.deck.date`, and `.deck.properties`) and per-slide metadata under the reserved top-level key `slide` (`.slide.number`/`.slide.total`); arbitrary author keys are grouped under `.deck.properties` so they cannot collide with `title`/`author`/`date`; (c) `deck` and `slide` are added to the reserved template names (`body`, `notes`, `_format`) and rejected at load time (template-build-checks, domain.constraint.template-context-reserved); (d) property values are simple typed YAML scalars only (string/number/boolean/date) — a mapping or sequence is a config error — passed as typed values with strings escaped, not Markdown and not pre-rendered HTML (domain.constraint.deck-properties-typed-scalars); (e) `.slide.number` is the 1-based position in the deck's flattened presentation order (each numbered slide, then its letter children) and `.slide.total` is the number of slide files, both derived at render time and never read from frontmatter (domain.constraint.slide-metadata-derived). The context is injected into the slide layout data and into every section instance map so a section (e.g. a footer) sees it at every composition depth. Spine: deck-properties + template-context (+ deck-data-in-templates, slide-metadata, section-template-context) → domain.value.deck-properties / domain.value.deck-config / domain.value.slide-metadata / domain.entity.section / domain.group.templating / domain.service.render-deck → solution.component.renderer, with domain.value.* realising through their containing groups (value nodes cannot carry realised-by).
